Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
What happens if a minion calls a vote to have Sheldon declared Nosferatu
Justicar and the vote passes. Does he contest his own title? Or does he
merely lose his "old" title and gain an identical "new" title?

John W.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
John Whelan (jbwh...@dorsai.org) wrote:
: What happens if a minion calls a vote to have Sheldon declared Nosferatu

: Justicar and the vote passes. Does he contest his own title? Or does he
: merely lose his "old" title and gain an identical "new" title?

He loses his old title as soon as he gains a new one.
